decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the Heston Village Conservation Area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension with a roof terrace, erection of a front entrance porch, construction of a flat roof to replace the existing mono pitch roof over existing side extension, and conversion of integral garage into a habitable room incorporating the installation of a side window.
